headline: AI music generator Suno hacked, source code reportedly details YouTube scraping
summary: A hacker claims to have accessed Suno's source code, revealing alleged scraping of millions of songs from YouTube Music, Deezer, and other platforms, along with customer data.
details: AI music generator Suno was reportedly hacked, according to a report from 404 Media. The hacker claims to have used a supply chain attack to gain access to an employee's credentials.

This access allegedly led to the compromise of Suno's source code. The hacker states the code details how Suno scraped audio from YouTube Music, Deezer, Genius, stock music libraries, and podcast RSS feeds.
Customer data was also reportedly accessed, including customer emails, phone numbers, and partial credit card numbers stored with Stripe. The breach reportedly occurred in November 2025.
Suno did not notify its customers about the incident. The company has described it as a "limited security incident that was quickly contained."

headline: OpenAI launches $230 Codex Micro hardware in collaboration with Work Louder
summary: OpenAI has officially released its first hardware product, the Codex Micro, a collaboration with Work Louder, priced at $230.
details: OpenAI has officially released its first hardware product, the Codex Micro, a collaboration with Work Louder. This new device is priced at $230, marking OpenAI's entry into the physical product market.
The company had previously teased Codex-branded hardware last month, building anticipation for this launch. The Codex Micro is now available, expanding OpenAI's ecosystem beyond software.
